notes: Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.x class micro-quad, stock 7 mm coreless motors and 45 mm props. Literature-derived from published system identification (mainly Forster 2015, ETH Zurich). Not measured by this project. Battery sag is off by default because internal resistance is UNCONFIRMED. Known source errors: one paper's table prints the mass 10x too large (0.27 kg); some widely copied simulators use a torque-to-thrust ratio of 0.0251 m, 4 to 6 times the identified value.

airframe.mass_kg.source: Forster 2015 Table 2.2 p.17; Bitcraze CF2.1 datasheet 29 g; firmware CF_MASS 0.029

airframe.inertia_kg_m2.source: Forster 2015 Appendix A p.57; ranges span Eschmann, Luis and Le Ny, Landry

airframe.arm_length_m.source: Bitcraze firmware ARM_LENGTH 0.046; Landry 92 mm motor to motor; Luis and Le Ny 39.73 mm (competing definition)

airframe.drag_coefficient.source: no body-drag source found for this class
airframe.drag_coefficient.note: Body drag is UNCONFIRMED (no sourced value), so it is switched off by default. Sweep it separately if needed.

airframe.cross_sectional_area_m2.note: Irrelevant while drag is off; kept only because the schema requires the field.

rotor.spin_directions.source: standard X quad, diagonal pairs spin the same way
rotor.spin_directions.note: Order front-left, front-right, rear-right, rear-left; +1 is counterclockwise seen from above.

rotor.thrust_coefficient_n_s2.source: derived from Forster eq 3.3 (thrust map) and eq 3.4 (speed map) near hover; Luis and Le Ny theory 2.88e-8; Bitcraze stand 2.28e-8 at max
rotor.thrust_coefficient_n_s2.note: Derived, not printed: thrust per rotor at hover divided by hover speed squared from Forster's two fitted maps.

rotor.torque_to_thrust_m.source: Forster eq 3.5 p.29; Eschmann Sec IV-A; Bitcraze firmware THRUST2TORQUE
rotor.torque_to_thrust_m.note: The 0.0251 m value in some simulators is an outlier and is excluded.

rotor.max_speed_rad_s.source: set so k_f w_max^2 equals the cross-checked max thrust 0.1539 N (Forster p.27, eq 3.3 at cmd 64000)
rotor.max_speed_rad_s.note: w_max = sqrt(0.1539 N / 1.9e-08) = 2846.0 rad/s. Forster's speed map gives 3052 rad/s at full command, but rotor speed is the least reliable quantity, so thrust is matched instead.

rotor.motor_time_constant_s.source: Eschmann Sec IV-A 0.072 s; Bitcraze step response about 0.073 s; Forster H2(z) gives 0.0647 s

rotor.prop_radius_m.source: Landry p.26 45 mm prop; Luis and Le Ny 23.1348 mm
